### Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We can build powerful systems while keeping people firmly in charge of their design, deployment, and decisions.

2. We believe superintelligent AI built in the next 20 years will remain fully under human control. Human oversight is not an afterthought; it is how we ensure these systems serve people.

3. Superintelligent AI does not have to mean losing control. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control—and we are committed to making that future real.

### Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. That conviction shapes how we approach this moment: with confidence in our ability to guide powerful technologies and a clear commitment to keeping people in charge. Human control means more than setting rules after systems are built. It means making deliberate choices about how AI is designed, deployed, and governed, and ensuring people retain authority over consequential decisions. The future of AI is not something that simply happens to us. We can shape it, and we will. As development accelerates, we are focused on the work that makes this promise real: building systems that serve human priorities and preserving meaningful oversight at every step.
